attributes.note_text: System-level perception block. Missed detections within D_detection_range are the dominant safety concern; detection must complete within T_detection_window. The initial system does not monitor its own health or its operating conditions — both are gaps to be closed by a requirements update (see the linked tasks).
Operator interface. Responsible for start sequencing and correct indication of the actual system state; misleading state indication can defeat the safety concept.
System-level warning function. Must alert the operator within FTT at a safe alarm level and with the correct bearing/distance.
